definitions.gloss: diesel fuel; gas oil; light oil
definitions.explanation: A petroleum product used as fuel for diesel engines. Called 'light oil' in Japanese because it is lighter than heavy oil, though it is not the same as gasoline.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{軽油|けいゆ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
{軽油|けいゆ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: The price of diesel went up again.

examples.japanese: ⟦ガソリンスタンド→ガソリンスタンド：01348_gasorinsutando⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{間違|まちが}えて→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧{軽油|けいゆ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧しまう⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦エンジン→エンジン：03835_enjin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れる→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If you accidentally put diesel in at the gas station, it can damage the engine.

notes:
Composed of {軽|けい} (light) and {油|ゆ} (oil). Despite the name 'light oil,' {軽油|けいゆ} refers specifically to diesel fuel, not to a lighter form of gasoline. The name distinguishes it from ⟦{重油|じゅうゆ}→重油：21768_juuyu⟧ (heavy oil/bunker fuel).

CAUTION FOR LEARNERS:
At Japanese gas stations, fuel nozzles are color-coded: green for {軽油|けいゆ} (diesel), red for ⟦レギュラー→レギュラー：11396_regyuraa⟧ (regular gasoline), and yellow for ハイオク (premium gasoline). Do not confuse {軽油|けいゆ} with ⟦{軽|けい}{自動車|じどうしゃ}→軽自動車：14298_keijidousha⟧ (kei car) — kei cars typically run on gasoline, not diesel.

- {軽油|けいゆ}⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧ — diesel vehicle
